subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-16 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋辞职后传复出；ULA火神火箭首败毁40颗卫星；国会收紧AI芯片出口
headline_en: Jensen Huang weighs Nvidia return; ULA's Vulcan fails, destroying 40 satellites; Congress tightens AI chip export rules

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋考虑重返英伟达任CEO
items.title_en: Jensen Huang weighs return as Nvidia CEO
items.body_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，黄仁勋已与亲信讨论重返英伟达担任CEO的可能性，其硅谷盟友正组建“作战室”向董事会施压，并计划争取白宫支持。英伟达董事会目前仍在进行独立调查。
items.body_en: Jensen Huang has discussed a possible return as Nvidia CEO with confidants, and allies are forming a Silicon Valley "war room" to pressure the board and seek White House backing, the Financial Times reported. The board is still conducting an independent investigation.

items.title_zh: 美国国会拟收紧AI芯片出口规则
items.title_en: Congress moves to tighten AI chip export rules
items.body_zh: 在黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有关的丑闻曝光后，美国民主党和共和党均表态支持多项收紧AI芯片出口的法案，并要求黄仁勋等人作证。此举可能进一步限制先进芯片流入中国。
items.body_en: After a scandal involving Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Democrats and Republicans alike have backed bills to tighten AI chip exports and demanded testimony from Huang and others. The move could further restrict advanced chips reaching China.

items.title_zh: 印度芯片初创Bharat Semi获2400万美元种子轮
items.title_en: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round
items.body_zh: Bharat Semi宣布完成2400万美元种子轮融资，其AI传感器技术已获得通用原子等公司的设计订单。该公司瞄准全球AI传感器市场。
items.body_en: Bharat Semi has raised a $24 million seed round and says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies including General Atomics. The startup is targeting the global AI sensor market.

items.title_zh: 微软进一步封锁eMudhra根证书
items.title_en: Microsoft blocks more eMudhra root certificates
items.body_zh: 微软自11月16日起移除印度数字证书机构eMudhra剩余10张根证书的默认信任，依赖这些证书的网站和服务可能出现验证失败。无法联网的Windows设备需手动部署后续更新包。
items.body_en: Microsoft has removed default trust for the remaining 10 eMudhra root certificates from Nov 16, which may cause certificate validation failures for sites and services relying on them. Offline Windows devices will need to deploy follow-up update packages manually.

items.title_zh: 纽约市立法禁止算法个性化定价
items.title_en: NYC passes ban on algorithmic personalized pricing
items.body_zh: 纽约市议会11月12日通过法案，禁止企业利用消费者个人数据和算法对相同商品或服务收取不同价格，违规者最高面临每项1000美元罚款。该法案适用于纽约市五个行政区。
items.body_en: New York City Council passed a bill on Nov 12 banning companies from using personal data and algorithms to charge different prices for the same goods or services, with fines up to $1,000 per violation. It applies across the city's five boroughs.

items.title_zh: 韩国税务考试最高分者承认用AI作弊
items.title_en: Top scorer in South Korea tax exam admits AI cheating
items.body_zh: 34岁的韩元锡承认在税务会计师考试中利用隐藏摄像头和AI获取近乎满分的成绩，160道题仅错1道。此事引发对AI辅助作弊的广泛关注。
items.body_en: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the tax accountancy exam, answering 159 of 160 questions correctly. The case has raised broader concerns about AI-assisted cheating.

items.title_zh: ULA火神火箭首飞失败，40颗亚马逊卫星被毁
items.title_en: ULA's Vulcan rocket fails, destroying 40 Amazon satellites
items.body_zh: 联合发射联盟（ULA）的火神火箭在发射中失败，未能将40颗亚马逊Leo卫星送入轨道，这是ULA成立20年来首次任务全败。Leo是SpaceX星链的竞争对手，此次挫折令其组网进度进一步落后。
items.body_en: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket failed during launch, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites and marking the first total mission failure in ULA's 20-year history. Leo, Amazon's Starlink competitor, has struggled to get off the ground and now falls further behind.

items.title_zh: 苹果首款智能眼镜或于明年6月发布
items.title_en: Apple's first smart glasses may arrive in June
items.body_zh: 彭博社的马克·古尔曼称，苹果首款不具AR功能的智能眼镜将在明年6月的WWDC上发布，但发货可能还要更晚。这是苹果在可穿戴设备领域的新尝试。
items.body_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says Apple's first smart glasses, which will lack AR features, will be announced at WWDC next June, though shipments may begin later. It marks Apple's new push into wearable devices.

items.title_zh: 泽连斯基呼吁马斯克解除星链限制
items.title_en: Zelensky urges Musk to lift Starlink restrictions
items.body_zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，星链网速被限制导致乌军难以阻止俄罗斯的袭击，呼吁美国和马斯克站在“历史正确的一边”。星链在乌克兰战场通信中扮演关键角色。
items.body_en: Ukrainian President Zelensky said slowed Starlink internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks, urging the US and Musk to be on the "right side of history." Starlink plays a critical role in Ukraine's battlefield communications.

items.title_zh: 美国提议乌克兰以顿巴斯换北约席位
items.title_en: US floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for NATO seat
items.body_zh: 泽连斯基透露，美国提出了一项新的欧洲安全框架，内容包括乌克兰放弃顿巴斯以换取北约成员国资格。该提议能否被俄乌接受尚待观察。
items.body_en: Zelensky said the US floated a new European security framework under which Ukraine would cede Donbas in exchange for NATO membership. Whether Russia and Ukraine would accept the proposal remains to be seen.

items.title_zh: 捷克数十万人抗议公共媒体资金改革
items.title_en: Hundreds of thousands protest Czech public media funding reform
items.body_zh: 布拉格爆发数十万人参加的抗议活动，反对政府改变公共广播机构的资金模式，示威者称此举将压制媒体自由。这是自天鹅绒革命以来捷克最大规模的抗议之一。
items.body_en: Hundreds of thousands rallied in Prague against the government's plan to change how public broadcasters are funded, with protesters saying it would stifle media freedom. It is one of the largest protests in the Czech Republic since the Velvet Revolution.

quick_zh: SpaceX星舰于周六成功返回，展示了可重复使用能力。
中国最长二氧化碳长输管道投运，全长277.6公里，年输送330万吨。
2026年度中国电影票房突破320亿元。
quick_en: SpaceX's Starship returned successfully on Saturday, demonstrating reusability.
China's longest CO2 pipeline, 277.6 km with 3.3 million tonnes annual capacity, began operation.
China's 2026 box office has surpassed 32 billion yuan.
